architectural_decisions.reasoning: The Agentic Layer is real and pinned in SPEC section 11a
File-backed State Engine as cross-session memory (agent_state.json + checkpoint.mjs)
Agents live in apps/agents/{branch}, not packages/
Deterministic-first routing; LLM as bounded fallback
Hybrid local/cloud inference; privilege never leaves the box
Governed sub-agents — grants, never ambient authority
Live ops stream — agents cook in the open (SSE)
createExpertAgent kit is the society's genome: every expert descends from it, persona+vocab are the only per-member deltas
Fleet self-evaluation loop: metrics-aggregator + read-only evaluator
Runtime evolution: validated spawn, zero default grants, -spawned marker, core protected
Python sidecar workers, stdlib-only, RESP2 socket client, toolbox not decision-maker
Model matrix with Leader-lending; secrecy > pin > lend
One RESP client per language; queue bridge honest degradation

Uploaded files → Leader conversation sandboxes: FileIntelligenceService (sha256-first, py tools preferred, inline-TEXT fallback when queue down with honest status) PlacementService vocabularyScore ties into same fleet routing; LeaderConversationService owner-scoped chat+voice, turns cap=100, no grant bypass
